title: Full Stack Engineer
requirements: We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with 3-5 years of professional experience to join our B2C marketplace team. You should be proficient in React and TypeScript on the frontend, and comfortable building services in Node.js. Experience designing and consuming GraphQL APIs is required. Familiarity with PostgreSQL for relational data modeling is expected, and prior exposure to Next.js or Tailwind CSS is a plus. You should be comfortable owning a feature end to end, from database schema to shipped UI, and communicating trade-offs with product stakeholders. Experience working in a marketplace or e-commerce environment with real-time inventory and checkout flows is strongly preferred.
responsibilities: You will build and maintain buyer-facing storefront features on our multi-vendor marketplace, working across the React/TypeScript frontend and our Node.js/GraphQL backend. Day to day, you will implement new checkout and cart experiences, extend our GraphQL schema to support new seller tools, and collaborate with design and product on search and discovery improvements. You will also participate in code review, write integration tests for critical purchase flows, and help triage production issues affecting buyers or sellers during peak shopping periods. Occasional on-call rotation is required to support checkout reliability during promotional events.
construction_rationale: Grade 3: exact title, full core stack (React/TypeScript/Node.js/GraphQL), mid seniority, marketplace domain — squarely the role Carol searches for.

title: Full-Stack Developer, Wholesale Platform
requirements: Craterworks operates a B2B wholesale ordering platform connecting regional distributors with independent retailers. We're hiring a Full-Stack Developer with roughly 3+ years of experience to help scale our ordering and fulfillment tools. Required skills include React and TypeScript for our buyer-facing dashboard, Node.js for backend services, and hands-on experience building or consuming GraphQL APIs. Working knowledge of PostgreSQL is necessary for reporting and inventory queries. Bonus points for Next.js experience, since our newer dashboards are being migrated to it, and for comfort with Tailwind CSS in a component-driven design system. Wholesale, distribution, or B2B commerce background is a strong plus but not mandatory.
responsibilities: You'll work on the retailer-facing ordering dashboard, adding bulk order features, price-tier logic, and delivery scheduling tools used by hundreds of retail partners daily. Expect to write React/TypeScript components, extend Node.js services that back our GraphQL API, and collaborate with the operations team to translate warehouse workflows into software. You will pair with a data engineer on inventory sync jobs, review pull requests from teammates, and take ownership of at least one subsystem — currently the returns and credit-memo flow — including its GraphQL resolvers and PostgreSQL schema.
construction_rationale: Grade 3: exact-synonym title, full core stack present, mid seniority, B2B wholesale marketplace domain — a plausible alternate niche within e-commerce.

title: full stack engineer (subscriptions team) 🚀
requirements: hey! we're loopcrate, a subscription-box commerce startup, and we need a full stack engineer to join our small subscriptions team. you'll fit right in if you've got a few years shipping production react + typescript apps and aren't scared of backend work in node.js. we lean hard on graphql for our api layer (apollo server + client), so you should be comfortable there or eager to get comfortable fast. postgres knows all our subscription state so sql chops matter. next.js and tailwind are bonus points since that's most of our frontend stack these days. we move fast, ship often, and don't do a ton of process — you should be the kind of person who's fine with that.
responsibilities: you'll be heads-down on our subscription management experience — think plan upgrades, pause/skip logic, and the billing preview screen customers hit every renewal cycle. that means react/typescript components, graphql mutations against our node.js api, and the occasional gnarly postgres query when something's off in prod. you'll ship your own features from idea to deploy, pair with our one other full stack engineer on trickier bits, and jump on customer-reported bugs when support flags them. no big ceremony here — mostly slack threads, quick standups, and shipping.
construction_rationale: Grade 3: startup-casual register, full core stack, mid seniority, subscription-commerce niche — same axes as the other grade-3 postings but deliberately different tone and formatting style.

title: Software Engineer, Full Stack — Storefront Team
requirements: Meridian Trade Group is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Storefront team, supporting the online marketplace used by over 40,000 independent sellers. Candidates should have a minimum of three years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated proficiency in TypeScript and React for building complex, stateful user interfaces. Backend experience with Node.js is required, along with practical experience designing GraphQL schemas and resolvers. A working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including query optimization, is expected. Experience with Next.js for server-rendered pages and Tailwind CSS for styling is preferred but not mandatory. Candidates should be comfortable operating with moderate autonomy and collaborating cross-functionally with product managers and designers.

Your daily work will involve writing React and TypeScript on the frontend, implementing GraphQL resolvers and Node.js services on the backend, and writing PostgreSQL migrations as our data model evolves. construction_rationale: Grade 3: formal register, plain 'Software Engineer' with explicit 'Full Stack' qualifier in the title, full core stack, mid seniority, marketplace domain — still an exact fit.
